title: Panama Disease Is Chasing The One Banana The World Exports
hook: The banana aisle depends on clones sharing one fungal weakness.
closing: If the Cavendish falls, your cheap banana could vanish because no export backup is ready.
question: Have you tried another variety?

segments.say: Nearly every banana shipped abroad, 99 percent, is a Cavendish. The global trade depends on essentially the same fruit.
Over 1,000 banana varieties exist, yet only one is exported. The world's supply has almost no backup.
Panama disease now reaches three continents, up from one in 1990. Cavendish clones share the weakness it attacks.
